links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT versus physician responses to preterm infant care questions
links.effect: ChatGPT responses exhibited higher semantic richness and were more difficult to read than human experts' responses, although understandability ratings were higher (4.12 vs 3.70).
links.quote: ChatGPT provided more comprehensive and elaborative information, though its responses exhibited higher semantic richness and were more difficult to read.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-4o responses to online preterm infant care questions compared to neonatologists' responses using human expert and lay user evaluation, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
